name: sample-bigquery-to-aws-migration
description: Assess migrating a BigQuery warehouse to an AWS lakehouse (S3 Tables / Apache Iceberg + Amazon Redshift or Amazon Athena).

plugins.name: bq-assess
plugins.description: Read-only BigQuery migration assessment: per-table Migration Effort and Query Complexity scoring, Iceberg DDL, engine recommendation (Athena vs Redshift), and a BigQuery-vs-AWS cost comparison — as a Python CLI plus a guided Claude Code skill.
